subject: ENGLISH
title: More Than One · M01 D07
objective: Form regular plurals with -s or -es in taught examples.
introduction: Many nouns add -s; some nouns ending in s, x, z, sh, or ch add -es. Other nouns follow different patterns. Explore examples, sort cards, practice, and answer five questions.

vocabulary.definition: A word that names a person, place, or thing.
The last part of a story or word.
More than one, like cats or boxes.
